# Get all hourly data for Oct 5, 2025
query = text("""
SELECT hsaq.station_id, hsaq.datetime, hsaq.o3, hsaq.no2, aqs.station_type
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id

""")
